$comment: <direct.h>, <dirent.h> and <sys/stat.h> on pe are the REFERENCES' surface — no more, no less (P68 round 9, the coordinator's ruling (a) on D-CONFIG-SYS-STAT-OVER-DECLARES-S-ISLNK-ON-PE). This directory used to witness a DECLARED SUPERSET DEVIATION (LANE-CFG edits 2/4, 3/4 and 4/4): on pe, <direct.h> pulled <dirent.h>, <dirent.h> pulled <windows.h>, and <sys/stat.h> defined `S_ISLNK(m)` as `(0)` — three edges neither Windows reference has. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-23: `DIR` + `readdir` from a bare <direct.h> is rc=1 under mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 and rc=2 under MSVC 14.51 (`/std:clatest`), against an `_mkdir` control that is rc=0 on both; <dirent.h> gives no `DWORD`/`HANDLE` under mingw (rc=1) and does not exist under MSVC (C1083); neither defines `S_ISLNK` or `S_IFLNK` (`#ifdef` probes). The ruling removed all three, because DSS's shipped surface for a target is the platform references' surface and a harness need is met by the harness's own shims, handed to both compilers — never by a deviation every Windows reference then fails. (<windows.h> → <stdlib.h> stays: both references make `malloc`/`free` visible through <windows.h>, rc=0.) The directory keeps its name as the record of what it once witnessed. main.c now PINS the absence at preprocessing time (`#error` if `S_ISLNK`/`S_IFLNK` are defined on pe — an `#ifdef` cannot be satisfied by an implicit declaration) and uses at run time what pe really has: the directory API through <dirent.h> (mingw-w64 ships it; DSS realizes it from `runtime/platform/src/dirent.c`), <direct.h>'s own `_getcwd`, the `<sys/stat.h>` mode tests and the `S_IRWXG`/`S_IRWXO`/`_S_IREAD`/`S_IREAD` rows added this round; the elf/macho legs take the POSIX arm, where `S_ISLNK`/`S_IFLNK`/`S_ISUID`/`S_ISGID`/`S_ISVTX` exist with their real values. ✔MEASURED: gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 (x86_64 Linux), aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc 13.3.0 (qemu), mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 and Apple clang 21.0.0 on arm64 and x86_64 (the POSIX arm; the coordinator's Mac runs) all run it to 42; MSVC ships no <dirent.h>. RED-ON-DISABLE, ✔MEASURED 2026-09-23: restoring the pe `S_ISLNK` arm stops the pe build at the `#error` (debug and release) while the ELF legs stay at 42.
